english.title: Deliver document/make statement that is misleading/false/deceptive - Reports on Payments to Governments Regulations 2014
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse

(A)_[delivered or caused to be delivered, a document]_
(B)_[made a statement]_

namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT OR STATEMENT..) to the registrar, for the purposes of the Reports on Payments to Governments Regulations 2014, that was misleading, false or deceptive, in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16 of the Reports on Payments to Governments Regulations 2014.

english.notes:
(i) No proceedings are to be brought for an offence under this regulation in England and Wales except by or with the consent of the Secretary of State or the Director of Public Prosecutions.
(ii) This is the basic form of this offence, for the aggravated form of this offence committed where a person knowingly delivers or causes to be delivered a document that is misleading, false or deceptive see H101615.
